prose.subject: Payment Required: Larchmont Analytics Report Access
prose.body:
You are requesting access to the Q3 Consumer Behavior Insight Report from Larchmont Analytics. This comprehensive document includes detailed analysis of user engagement trends, demographic breakdowns, and predictive modeling results for the third quarter.

To unlock the full report, please complete the payment of 2279.55 USDC. The transaction will be sent directly to our secure receiving wallet: 0x1aa424df63d62cf9a1f9dcb12ea78cd69ae53aa1. 

Once your transaction is confirmed on the network, you will receive immediate access to the downloadable PDF and dataset files. If you have already sent the payment but are still seeing this message, please allow a few minutes for the blockchain confirmation. 

For billing inquiries, contact our support team at billing@larchmont-analytics.example. We appreciate your business and look forward to providing you with valuable market intelligence.
